sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Shooting Cans is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Greetings! I hear you're looking for a little extra cash. That's perfect, because I have a job for you... I know that the city center is where AGSs and KORDs were deployed during the hottest fights. Find me one of each and report back. Also, sweep the area around them, make sure no one gets to the firing positions before my guys do. I think five bodies will be enough. Scavs, PMCs, whatever. Less trespassers, less chance of an ambush, you know?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the Utyos machine gun on Ground Zero
- Locate the AGS grenade launcher on Ground Zero
- Eliminate any 5 targets on Ground Zero

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Prapor Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"You did it? Well done! Maybe you could really be useful."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to find the Utyos machine gun and the AGS grenade launcher on Ground Zero, as well as kill any 5 entities on the location.

sections.heading: Utyos
sections.text: The Utyos machine gun is located in an office on the third floor (labeled 5) of the Tarbank building.

sections.heading: AGS
sections.text: The AGS grenade launcher is located in the back office on the third floor of the Capital Insight building.
